page: Amazon Web Services m8in.96xlarge is a general-purpose instance based on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor and powered by Intel x86_64 architecture processors. The configuration supplies 192 physical CPU cores and 384 virtual processors with two threads per core, with clock frequencies reaching 3.9 GHz. System memory totals 1536.0 GB, maintaining an allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Networking capabilities are defined by a 600 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external EBS volumes or network storage solutions for file systems and databases. Furthermore, the instance does not include discrete GPUs or hardware accelerators.

By delivering a large volume of dedicated compute cores paired with high-bandwidth networking, the m8in.96xlarge allows significant resource consolidation within a single node. The architecture fits enterprise-scale distributed processing, large memory-backed services, parallel compilation, and network-intensive backend applications.
